Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 2026

OfficialUM1 LLC ('we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, process, and safeguard your information when you visit our website (https://officialum1.com) and utilize our digital services.

1. Information We Collect

  • Personal Identification Information: Name, business email address, phone number, and company details provided when submitting contact inquiries, registering an account, or placing orders.
  • Billing & Payment Information: Payment card details are processed directly by our PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways (such as Stripe). We do not store full credit card numbers or security CVV codes on our servers.
  • Technical & Usage Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages viewed, and referral URLs collected automatically for performance optimization, security monitoring, and fraud prevention.

2. How We Use Your Information

We process your data for legitimate business purposes, including:

  • Provisioning and delivering purchased web development, SEO, and digital consulting services.
  • Processing transactions, issuing invoices, and providing real-time order updates.
  • Responding to support tickets, customer inquiries, and consultation requests.
  • Complying with legal obligations, tax regulations, and preventing fraudulent transactions.

3. Data Protection & Security

We employ robust administrative, technical, and physical safeguards—including SSL/TLS encryption, secure server architecture, and tokenized authorization—to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We only share data with trusted third-party service providers (such as payment processors, hosting infrastructure, and email delivery providers) strictly necessary to operate our business and fulfill services for you.

5. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use essential and analytical cookies to maintain your authenticated session, remember user preferences, and analyze site traffic to improve overall user experience. You can modify your browser settings to decline cookies if preferred.

6. Your Data Rights (GDPR & CCPA Compliance)

Depending on your location, you have rights to:

  • Access and request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal records.
  • Request deletion of your personal data (the 'Right to be Forgotten'), subject to legal record retention requirements.
  • Opt out of marketing communications at any time.

7. Contact Our Privacy Officer

If you have any questions, requests, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
